objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type-based abbreviation code with consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier incremented on each revision or change.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language in which the document is authored.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Configurable period for validity extension check (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment mirroring the main document release process.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version identifier of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary object linked to a document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal for changing an existing released document, managed independently of the document version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal (e.g., Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and withdraw it from circulation, triggering an archiving workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restricted to the Business Admin Group.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification category for documents defining level, template availability, type abbreviation, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code prefix used in document abbreviations for this type.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level in the document pyramid (e.g., Level 2 for guidelines, Level 4 for work instructions).

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents to pre-populate structure and TAG-based metadata.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person assigned as the primary responsible creator and editor of a document, automatically set upon document creation.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned additional write permissions on a document to assist the author, without relevance in the release workflow signing step.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person responsible for checking the content of a document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for final approval and release of a document, deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who translates released document content into another language, without the ability to create new objects independently.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or acknowledgement authorizations and distribution targeting for documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: The configured list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures and email notifications.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g., Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signed confirmation by a workflow participant documented per released version for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Identity of the person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was provided.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation by a reader that they have read and noted a released document version, tracked via workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

objs.name: client
objs.description: An organizational tenant in a multi-client system where document visibility can be configured per document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step confirming document creation/editing.

evts.name: perform_review
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness and completes the review task with an electronic signature.

attributes.name: review_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the review.

evts.name: perform_release
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document with an electronic signature, making it available to readers.

attributes.name: release_outcome
attributes.description: Positive approval or rejection of the release.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided for the rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment object is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author-rights user creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: perform_override
evts.description: The document is declared Out of Force, rights are revoked except for the archive group, and the archive duration begins.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin Group member creates a request to reactivate an invalidated document.

evts.name: perform_reactivation
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period expires, the archived document is physically deleted from the system.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document version via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released via a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

o2o.description: Each document belongs to exactly one document type that defines its level, templates, validity period, and archive duration.
Each document type can have one or more document templates available for selection at creation.
An attachment is a controlled sub-document that belongs to a specific main document.
An additional information object is supplementary content belonging to a specific document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request is created for a specific document to initiate its invalidation.
A reactivation request references the specific invalidated document to be reactivated.
Each document has a distribution list defining user groups and persons for notification and acknowledgement.
A distribution list contains user groups whose members receive document access and notifications.
A document has an assigned author who is the primary responsible person for its content.
A document may have one or more co-authors with write permissions.
A document has one or more assigned reviewers for technical and formal content checks.
A document has one or more assigned releasers for final approval.
In a multi-client system, a document can be configured as visible or invisible in specific clients.
A document can reference other documents via the References attribute, including local extensions in other clients.
